parts.name: buckle_helmet_half
sources: A side-release buckle of acetal for webbing of 20 mm; its sizes by eye.

parts.name: liner_helmet_half
sources: The liner (đệm hấp thụ xung động): EPS of 30 mm and 45 kg/m3, the least thickness and the middle density of a liner (Trzaskalska and Chwastek, 2021).

parts.name: pad_helmet_half
sources: The comfort pad (lớp vải lót, đệm lót trong): PU foam of 3 mm (30 kg/m3, The Engineering ToolBox), on the headform; it gives the fit, not the protection (GRSP, Helmet standards guide, 2025).

parts.name: peak_helmet_half
sources: The peak (lưỡi trai, QCVN 2:2021/BKHCN, 3.2.2): ABS of 3 mm, 40 mm out from the rim at the front, by eye.

parts.name: rivet_left_helmet_half
sources: A rivet of steel with a round head of 10 mm, 1.5 mm out from the shell (QCVN 2:2021/BKHCN, 5.4: at most 2 mm); by eye.

parts.name: rivet_right_helmet_half
sources: A rivet of steel with a round head of 10 mm, 1.5 mm out from the shell (QCVN 2:2021/BKHCN, 5.4: at most 2 mm); by eye.

parts.name: shell_helmet_half
sources: The shell: ABS of 4 mm, the least of a thermoplastic shell (Trzaskalska and Chwastek, Archives of Metallurgy and Materials 66, 2021), over the headform of the size 6 of QCVN 2:2021/BKHCN.

parts.name: strap_left_helmet_half
sources: Webbing of nylon, 20 mm wide and 1 mm thick.

parts.name: strap_right_helmet_half
sources: Webbing of nylon, 20 mm wide and 1 mm thick.

parts.name: trim_helmet_half
sources: The edge trim (bọc mép, QCVN 2:2021/BKHCN, Hình 2): rubber round the rim of the shell; its size by eye.
